title: Block Git No Verify
summary: A Claude Code hook that blocks git commit and git push calls using --no-verify, so pre-commit and pre-push checks always run.
description: When a pre-commit hook fails, an agent may try to get past it with a flag. This hook reads each Bash command and refuses any git call that carries --no-verify, plus the short -n form on commit.
The push flag -n means a dry run in git, so it is left alone. Text inside quotes, such as a commit message that mentions the flag, is ignored.
useWhen: Make sure lint and tests run before every commit
Stop the agent from bypassing a failing check
Enforce team hooks on local work
Keep secret scanners in the commit path

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',x=>d+=x).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){return}const i=j.tool_input||{};const c=String(i.command||'').replace(/\x22[^\x22]*\x22|\x27[^\x27]*\x27/g,' ')+' ';const t=c.split(/&&|[|][|]|[;|]/).map(s=>s+String.fromCharCode(32));const h=t.find(s=>/^[ ]*git[ ]/.test(s)&&(/--no-verify/.test(s)||(/[ ]commit[ ]/.test(s)&&/[ ]-[a-zA-Z]*n[a-zA-Z]*[ ]/.test(s))));if(h){console.error('Blocked: skipping git hooks hides failing checks. Fix what the pre-commit or pre-push hook reports, then run the command again without --no-verify.');process.exitCode=2}})"

example.prompt: The hook is slow. Commit with git commit --no-verify -m wip.
example.result: The commit is refused. The agent reads the hook output, fixes the failing check and commits normally.

faq.question: Does git push -n get blocked?
faq.answer: No. On push that flag only simulates the push, so it is allowed. The long --no-verify form is blocked everywhere.

faq.question: What if I truly need to skip hooks once?
faq.answer: Run the command yourself in your own terminal. The hook only guards commands the agent starts.

access: Reads each Bash command before it runs
Blocks matching commands and runs nothing itself
